I've pinged Abel and Georges to get the return label out and the correct BC04 moving. Stay in the chat if you can, one of them will jump in here, and if you step away it comes to your email.
(email hidden)

That matches the order, thanks. The label and the BC04 will go to (email hidden), and a copy of this chat lands there too once we're done.

Nothing else needed from you. Worth whitelisting us so the label mail doesn't drop into spam.
ok, thanks

The extra TH.  I think its worth the wait.  I also ordered two more BS-1
Makes sense. You've built up a lot of small units alongside that Magic Miner 40T. What's the pull of adding more little ones rather than putting it into one bigger miner?
Can i also check on two orders while Im here?

I ordered two BS-1.  Order #····-A and ····

Both are paid and both are still unshipped, the BS-1 White on each. Their ship date was September 22, so they're late, and the tracking we said would land within 24 hours on the 16th never did. Sorry about that.

I don't want to hand you a date I can't stand behind, so I've put both in front of Abel and Georges for a real one. Stay in the chat and one of them will jump in.
ok, thanks
Thanks for being patient with all of it, Frederick. The label for the WB200 and a date on the two BS-1s both go to (email hidden), and the full chat lands there too when we close it.
Sarah, I got to go.  Thanks for your help.  I'll wait for the email.
Take care, Frederick. Both are with the team and the emails will come to you. Good luck with the rigs.
